title: Hazel and the Compass
author: Paloma Underhill
blurb: Petra Voss, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
